status: Rules written before any genus hypothesis tests in this follow-up
analysis_scope: Exploratory follow-up of three cohorts selected during community review; not independent validation
sample_rule: All 12 positive-target bacterial samples in each cohort; no new depth exclusions

feature_rule.note: Apply within cohort, pooling treatments without looking at treatment associations. Database-assigned genus labels may include uncultured groups.

primary_transform: log2(count+0.5) minus sample mean log2(count+0.5) across all eligible genus labels in that cohort
primary_reference: All eligible genus labels for that cohort; fixed for every permutation
model: CLR ~ treatment (2023); CLR ~ collection_date + treatment (Petite Sirah 2024)
omnibus_test: Exact permutation F for the treatment term. Free assignments in 2023, assignments preserving counts of each treatment within each date in 2024. All group sizes three. Use label-invariant partitions with equal multiplicity.
hypothesis: No treatment association with a genus log-ratio to the specified reference, under within-date exchangeability
multiple_testing: BH across all eligible genus-by-cohort primary omnibus tests jointly; per-cohort BH provided as secondary context only; threshold 0.05

sensitivities.name: all_positive_reference
sensitivities.reference: all genus labels positive anywhere in the cohort including Unclassified_Genus

sensitivity_adjustment: Same joint BH family in each sensitivity; no replacement of primary estimates
contrasts: Each noncontrol treatment vs ControlFertigationOnly, from full additive OLS model; no pairwise hypothesis-test p values
uncertainty: Nominal model-based 95% t intervals assuming independent homoskedastic normal residuals; not simultaneous intervals; plus range of contrasts after each single-sample omission, not a confidence interval
robustness_reporting: Report primary and all sensitivity q values and effect directions separately, without selecting the most favorable transform
validation: Brute-force enumeration on toy designs; linear-model projections vs group sums; representative primary statistics vs R/lm numerical oracle if R is available, otherwise independent QR/SVD and direct residual sums; exact assignment counts and date balances; sample identity/abundance checks
limits: No established field randomization or technical batch adjustment
Unclassified reads remain in descriptive summaries but are not a biological genus
Community-screen-selected follow-up; adjusted p values are exploratory
Permutation validity requires exchangeability; unequal distributions/variances can affect interpretation
